speaker: Sheldon
text: All right, where are these amazing shrimp? Behold! Seriously, you think this is the size of a baby's arm? A little baby? I'm going back to the room.

speaker: Penny
text: Boy, would it maybe kill them to put out a nice brisket? Esther Rosenblatt.

speaker: Penny
text: I don't think the manager's coming tonight, so here.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Are you suggesting I sleep on the couch?

speaker: Penny
text: Well, it wasn't the first suggestion that came to mind, but it's the one I'm going with.

speaker: Sheldon
text: I can't sleep on your couch. I sleep in a bed. And given its dimensions, I have no intention of living out E.M. Snickering's beloved children's book, The Tall Man from Cornwall.

speaker: Sheldon
text: There was a tall man from Cornwall whose length exceeded his bed. My body fits on it, but barely upon it. There's no room for my big Cornish head.
